checkpoints.description: [1/2] Skip candidate event objects when no handler is installed

impact_assessment.benefits: Guard event construction behind a flag set only for a real handler, preserving decisions and all callback behavior
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no callback sees a different event stream; dependency: onEvent default; concurrency: process-local counter; state: none
impact_assessment.why: sweepCore built a progress object for every candidate even when the default no-op onEvent is used

[1/2] Share paired evidence across sweeps

impact_assessment.benefits: Create one paired-evidence cache per tune and reuse it in every sweep while keeping identical evidence
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical p-values and decisions; dependency: stats object identity; concurrency: process-local counter; state: cache scoped to one tune
impact_assessment.why: sweep-local evidence is rebuilt for the same cached report pairs that recur across axes and passes

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Skip unused rounded objects at intermediate looks

impact_assessment.benefits: Write rounded objects only for full reports and return slot matches with one Map lookup
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
